description:
Send files and links to a copyparty server by sharing them to this app

Features:
• sha512-verified uploads
• stash links and plaintext
• display/copy link to the uploaded files
• supports HTTP and HTTPS

Future ideas:
• upload slicing (resumable + usually faster)

This can be used to turn a raspi into a very flexible chromecast clone; see the readme for details
